spec.obtain: Cloudflare dashboard -> My Profile -> API Tokens -> Create Token (or use an existing one). It must carry the scopes your task needs; a READ-ONLY token cannot edit DNS/Workers/Pages.
gotchas: A read-only token returns code 10000 'Authentication error' on any WRITE (hive #268).
The token is account-scoped; confirm it targets the intended Cloudflare account.
